title: Funded project metadata (project.yml)
description: Metadata for one funded project, used by the rendered report site (docs/aggregate_reports.mjs).

title.description: Display title used on the report site.

proposal_issue.description: Link to the funding proposal issue.

status.description: Current status of the funded work.

funding_round.description: Funding round (e.g. "2025"); quote it if it looks like a number so it stays a string.

reports.description: Report files, relative to this folder: a glob, or a list of filenames and/or globs. Each report's date lives in its own frontmatter (date: "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY-MM-DD").
